name: Flattened Gaussian Ellipsoid Rendering
definition: A technique to approximate 2D Gaussian ellipses (surface-like representations) by flattening the 3D Gaussian ellipsoids.
summary: Flattened Gaussian Ellipsoid Rendering approximates 2D surfaces by flattening 3D Gaussian ellipsoids within a differentiable volume rendering framework that natively supports anisotropic kernels.
